meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: The new 2013-2014 salary schedule will be the “grandfathered salary schedule” pursuant to Fla. Stat. §1012.22(1)(c)(1)(b).; The Parties further agree that effective June 30, 2014, a new Performance Salary Schedule is established pursuant to Fla. Stat. §1012.22(1)(c)(5) that will co-exist with the “grandfathered salary schedule”.; Instructional personnel employed pursuant to Fla. Stat. §121.091(9)(b)(c)3 (i.e. employed or re-employed retired personnel from Florida or elsewhere) are exempt from these provisions and notwithstanding this Section will be paid a salary equal to the Step 7 Salary on the Step Salary Schedule upon their employment with the District.; Upon being employed as instructional employees, such employees shall be issued an annual probationary contract per Fla. Stat. §1012.335(1)(c).; In the event the Parties fail to reach agreement during negotiations of this Section, the impasse process outlined in Florida Statutes Chapter 447 will be utilized to resolve any dispute or impasse.

meta_cites_federal_law_008.answer: The District has established a retirement program under IRS Code Section that defers taxation until retirement or other severance from employment and permits the employee to forfeit and allow the District to contribute each year all of his/her benefit dollars to this retirement plan.; Nothing herein shall be construed as denying any eligible employee from continuing his/her insurance(s) as provided under Federal COBRA rule and regulations.; All Parties are desirous of a program that allows partial premium discounts (within all legal parameters of IRS Section 125 plans and the Affordable Care Act).
